summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of EDUSENSE Sentiment Analysis feature (Tiwari 2024 hybrid lexicon+ML). 40/40 backend pytest cases pass, including 18 new sentiment tests covering schema validation, RBAC visibility (parent/teacher/principal), record CRUD, kind filter, summary aggregation, ownership-based delete, and 401/403/422 negative paths. All previously tested endpoints (auth, astrology, recommendations, students, analytics) continue to pass. Frontend Playwright flow verified: principal login → navbar Sentiment link → Principal dashboard 'Sentiment Lab' CTA + Sentiment overview card (positive/neutral/negative/mixed counters render) → /sentiment page with Analyze/History tabs → LLM analysis returns and SentimentResultCard renders all 8 NRC emotions, satisfaction/dissatisfaction progress bars, aspect-based sentiment with thesis-specific keys (Happiness Index, Active Participation, Sharing, Learning, Teaching Effectiveness, Instructor Quality), Polarity (0.92), Likert 4.80, key themes, and summary.

design_issues.screen: Principal Dashboard - Users by role pie chart
issues: Carry-over from iteration_1: Recharts ResponsiveContainer renders 0-height pie when wrapped Card has no fixed height. Legend appears, pie does not. Not retested in this iteration; still flagged.

action_items: (Carry-over) Fix Users-by-role pie chart on PrincipalDashboard (wrap Recharts ResponsiveContainer parent with explicit height e.g., h-72).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~715 lines. Approaching the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into modules: routes/auth.py, routes/astrology.py, routes/sentiment.py, routes/students.py, services/llm.py.

Sentiment teacher visibility query may double-fetch when 'kind' query param + $or are combined; current implementation merges them correctly but the {**query, $or:[...]} pattern can silently drop the kind filter if a future $or includes overlapping fields. Consider building query via $and explicitly for clarity.

/api/sentiment/analyze and /api/sentiment/records both call run_sentiment() which makes a synchronous LLM call without timeout; long stalls could exhaust workers. Add asyncio.wait_for() with ~45s timeout.
SENTIMENT_SYSTEM aspect list is duplicated as a string-only contract; consider declaring an enum and validating returned aspect keys against it (currently any aspect key from the LLM is accepted).
/api/sentiment/summary aggregates over the entire collection on every call; for scale add an index on result.sentiment + kind or precompute counters.
Frontend Sentiment.jsx persist toggle is conditionally hidden when kind=standalone (correct UX) but the conditional rendering is implicit; add data-testid to its wrapper for easier testability.
FastAPI deprecation: still using @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); migrate to lifespan context manager.
CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True remains misconfigured per CORS spec (browsers block credentialed wildcard). Auth uses Bearer headers so currently safe.
test_credentials: Pre-seeded principal: principal@edusense.com / Admin@123. Test users created at runtime with TS-suffixed emails.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed parent/teacher users and 3 sentiment records per run, all cleaned up at end of suite (parent record self-deleted, teacher record principal-deleted, principal record cleaned up). Backend seeds principal admin idempotently on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py is single-file, 40 tests, ~70s runtime (LLM calls are the bottleneck). Sentiment endpoints (POST /api/sentiment/analyze, POST/GET/DELETE /api/sentiment/records, GET /api/sentiment/summary) are fully covered. RBAC matrix verified: parent sees own only, teacher sees own + all feedback + all journals (NOT principal's teacher_notes), principal sees all + can delete any. /api/sentiment/summary is principal+teacher only. UI testids: nav-sentiment-btn, principal-sentiment-btn, parent-sentiment-btn, teacher-sentiment-btn, sentiment-overview-card, sentiment-page-title, sentiment-tab-analyzer, sentiment-tab-history, sentiment-text-input, sentiment-analyze-btn, sentiment-label, sentiment-polarity, sentiment-likert, sentiment-summary, sentiment-history-filter. Use timeout >=75s for LLM result wait.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found. Carry-over: Users-by-role pie chart on Principal dashboard from iteration_1 still pending (parent Card has no explicit height; Recharts ResponsiveContainer height='100%' resolves to 0).
